r.locality: Woodland to 20 m of Eucalyptus tetrodonta, E. crebra and E. chartaboma.T2 layer 12-16m of Corymbia peltata, Corymbia spp. and E. tetrodonta. T3 layer 8-10 m of Aciac shirleyi, C. peltata, Corymbia spp., E. tetrodonta, Grevillea glauca and G. parallela. S1 layer of Acacia shirleyi, Alphitonia excelsa, Bossiaea armitii, Brachychiton paradoxus, Corymbia pocillum, E. tetrodonta, G. parallela, Hovea parvicalyx, Pogonolobus reticulatus and Xylomelum scottianum.
r.notes: The species was recorded as part of a fauna survey for a proposed wind farm. It was observed by Lyndall Harvey, Jeff Middleton and Simon Gleed from RPS GROUP.
